# Subway Seat for matplotlib

Charts on the walnut (or enamel) ground with parchment labels, quiet grid lines, and a color cycle that alternates warm and cool so neighboring series stay apart: burnt orange, seafoam, harvest gold, denim, redbird, avocado, terracotta. Saved figures keep the ground color.

[matplotlib](https://matplotlib.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/matplotlib/) · Needs matplotlib 3.4+

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only matplotlib
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.mplstyle`](subway-seat.mplstyle) | `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat.mplstyle`; that's the macOS folder; on Linux use ~/.config/matplotlib/stylelib/ (matplotlib.get_configdir() prints yours), or pass the file's path to plt.style.use |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.mplstyle`](subway-seat-tunnel.mplstyle) | `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat-tunnel.mplstyle`; that's the macOS folder; on Linux use ~/.config/matplotlib/stylelib/ (matplotlib.get_configdir() prints yours), or pass the file's path to plt.style.use |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.mplstyle`](subway-seat-enamel.mplstyle) | `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat-enamel.mplstyle`; that's the macOS folder; on Linux use ~/.config/matplotlib/stylelib/ (matplotlib.get_configdir() prints yours), or pass the file's path to plt.style.use |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your notebook or script:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.style.use("subway-seat")
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your notebook or script:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.style.use("subway-seat-tunnel")
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your notebook or script:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.style.use("subway-seat-enamel")
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat-tunnel.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat-enamel.mplstyle`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
